page.overview:
Who is Angrigo?

Angrigo was a male Duros assassin who was hired by Lieutenant Jenkes of the Galactic Empire's Security Bureau along with the Kratchell twins to kill the Trandoshan bounty hunter Bossk. However, he was instead killed by his target in Ake's Tavern on Lothal during a brief shootout.
